name: review-runner
description: Run the review pass for a given environment: read the spec and test set, filter the tests for the target environment, evaluate the diff against them, and write the review. Invoked by an orchestrator that hands over the environment and the working context.
role: Senior reviewer evaluating a change against its specification and test set.

env.desc: target environment for this review pass

task_dir.desc: path of the task folder holding 00_spec.md, 00_test.json, 03_review.md

git_diff.desc: output of git diff $(git merge-base HEAD main)...HEAD

item_max.desc: maximum number of test items to evaluate; if absent, evaluate all

todolist_resume.desc: updated todolist; present only when resuming an interrupted run

status.desc: overall outcome of the review pass

ROUTINE.TODO: Read the spec at {task_dir}/00_spec.md and the test set at {task_dir}/00_test.json
From the test set, keep only the entries where env == {env}. Call this subset test_entries_env. If item_max is provided, cap it at that many entries.
Evaluate git_diff against test_entries_env and the spec, recording a pass/fail and rationale for each entry

then.TODO: Set the review status to pass

else.TODO: Set the review status to fail and list the failing entries with their rationale
